verdict.rationale: Luma publishes per-model credit costs (e.g., 360p Draft 5s T2V/I2V at 20 credits) and uses a credit system, so a marketer can work out a generation's cost in advance from the pricing table. The docs also link a Billing Dashboard for tracking spend, but its contents are undocumented and there is no evidence of an in-product cost estimate before running a generation. Missing for 10: pre-run cost preview in the UI/API, documented spend-tracking or usage-history features, dollar-to-credit conversion detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: The Luma API uses a credit system, not a subscription.
